# Course Registration & Add/Drop Policy (Fictional Demo)

## Standard Credit Limits
Full-time undergraduate students may enroll in between 12 and 18 credits per regular semester.
Enrolling in more than 18 credits requires written approval from an Academic Advisor before the end of Week 2.

## Add/Drop Deadlines
Students may add or drop courses without academic penalty during the first 10 instructional days of the semester.
Drops submitted after Day 10 and before Week 8 are recorded as a Withdrawal (W) on the academic transcript.

## Waitlist Processing
Waitlisted students are enrolled automatically in queue order when a seat opens. Notifications are sent to the student's campus email and expire after 24 hours.
